about_short_description.short_description: Okendo is a customer content marketing platform.

product.name: Okendo Customer Marketing Platform
product.description: A platform that collects and displays customer-generated content such as reviews, ratings, and user-generated content to support e-commerce marketing efforts.

product.name: Okendo Reviews and UGC (User-Generated Content)
product.description: A service that collects and displays customer reviews and user-generated content to build social proof and influence purchasing decisions.

product.name: Okendo Surveys
product.description: A tool to collect actionable customer data through surveys to inform marketing and engagement strategies.

product.name: Okendo Quizzes
product.description: An interactive tool that guides shoppers through personalized quizzes to improve product recommendations and increase sales.

product.name: Okendo Loyalty Product
product.description: A rewards system that offers flexible customer incentives such as store credit and bonus points to encourage repeat purchases.

product.name: Okendo Integrations
product.description: A set of over 65 integrations that connect the Okendo platform with various e-commerce, marketing, and sales tools to streamline workflows and enhance customer experience.
